author: Tracie Black
text:
Kerry Cullen Agree! I’m following three dia-buddies on mine, including you, and one is a relative newby, so am reluctant to turn it off, in case she hasn’t got it under control. But….the nocturnal sirening is a nightmare! Some hypos can take longer than 15 minutes to get out of the red zone. 
Think also a toggle on the app to advise your followers that you’ve got it would be useful.
